name: Box Drive
location: Default reparse point to virtual filesystem: %USERPROFILE%\Box. Default local file cache: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Box\Box\cache. File metadata and configuration data: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Box\Box\logs\ (Box_Streem logs); %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Box\Box\data\ (sync.db and streemsfs.db = file metadata, metrics.db = user account info).
purpose: Box Drive presents its synced content as a virtual filesystem implemented through an NTFS reparse point rather than a real local copy, and it logs unusually detailed metadata for both locally cached and cloud-only files.
key_fields: streemsfs.db - virtual filesystem metadata database, including file hashes
Box_Streem logs - detailed operational logs under logs\; searchable for the value "logDriveInformation" to locate the virtual filesystem folder if its path is not otherwise apparent
normal_baseline: A single %USERPROFILE%\Box reparse point tied to one authenticated Box account, with sync.db/streemsfs.db metadata and cache growth tracking routine file access, and Box_Streem logs showing regular, unremarkable sync activity during working hours.
anomalies: streemsfs.db recording SHA1 hashes for a large batch of cloud-only files accessed or downloaded in a short window shortly before resignation or termination, consistent with data staging for exfiltration (T1567.002)
A Box Drive installation with no corresponding business justification or IT-issued account on a corporate endpoint
Box_Streem logs showing the virtual filesystem folder relocated away from the default %USERPROFILE%\Box path with no administrative change record
metrics.db reflecting an account identity that does not match the endpoint's assigned user, suggesting shared or unauthorized credential use
Gaps or truncation in Box_Streem logs beyond the normal several-week retention window that coincide with a known incident timeframe, limiting available detail
parsing_tools: Generic SQLite browser (e.g. DB Browser for SQLite) for sync.db, streemsfs.db, and metrics.db
Generic text/log viewer for Box_Streem logs
anti_forensic_notes: Because Box Drive implements its virtual filesystem as an NTFS reparse point rather than storing full file content locally by default, a directory listing of %USERPROFILE%\Box does not by itself prove file content was ever present on disk - streemsfs.db and sync.db must be examined to establish what was actually cached versus cloud-only. Box_Streem log retention is typically limited to a few weeks, so older activity may not be recoverable from logs alone even though the metadata databases can retain longer history.
interpretation: streemsfs.db and sync.db together cover metadata for both locally cached and cloud-only files, including SHA1 hashes useful for confirming file identity independent of filename. If the virtual filesystem folder location is not obvious from the reparse point, search Box_Streem logs for the string "logDriveInformation" to recover it. Detailed usage logging is available but generally only spans a few weeks, so timely collection matters more here than with some other cloud-sync clients.
